data.name: Dasyaar
data.gender_notes: Dasyaar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘daws’, meaning 'lion', and ‘yaar’, meaning 'friend'. This name signifies a brave and fearless companion. In Islamic history, it can be associated with Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions, who roared against oppression and stood up for truth. The name Dasyaar carries the meaning “Lion's roar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dasyaar usually hope their child will grow to embody lion's roar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of courage and unwavering determination in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Dasyaar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion's roar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dasyaar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hindi.name: दसयार
in_hindi.meaning: दसयार का अर्थ है जो अपने कामों पर नियंत्रण रखता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: दसयार एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है जो अपने कामों पर नियंत्रण रखता है या अपने कार्यों को व्यवस्थित करता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'स य र' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है चलना या गति करना।

in_pashto.name: دسیار
in_pashto.meaning: دسیار معنی یې هغه څوک چې خپل کارونه کنټرولوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: دسیار د یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم معنی یې هغه څوک چې خپل کارونه کنټرولوي یا منظموي. دا نوم د عربی ریښې 'س ي ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چی معنی یې چلول یا حرکت کول دي.

Dasyaar is a unique and meaningful name that reflects leadership and management qualities.
